runs.t: One August day, Tyler went outside to play tag with his friends. The sun was high in the sky. It felt like the hottest day of the year. As Tyler was running around, his face got redder and redder and he felt hotter and hotter. “It’s too hot outside to play tag,” Tyler called to his friends, “let’s go swimming instead.”

Tyler and his friends hopped on their bikes and rode to the pool. At the pool, they had a contest to see who could make the biggest splash in the water. Tyler made a pretty big splash, but his friends made bigger ones.
